svg.text: Search and advice databases: one per service
Each service owns its own database; these five tables have no foreign keys between them.
Dashed lines: advice.user_id and advice.trip_id are meant to refer to users and trips owned by the Trip service
(trip_db, Figure 13). They are plain values, not foreign keys; advice.user_id is free text today.
bold = NOT NULL (the id column and created_at are added to every table).
